verdict.rationale: Gide shows international venture capability in general terms: venture M&A "in France and internationally", international employee share schemes, and an 11-office network including New York and London backed by relationships with foreign firms. It does not document specific cross-border venture deals, and the cited Comeen/LumApps reference is not shown to be cross-border. Missing for 10: documented international-investor rounds, flip or redomiciliation work, multi-jurisdiction financing case studies, and independent corroboration of cross-border venture deals.
